scope: PHP interpreter and MySQL server CPE product families found in retrieved CVE records
important_limitations: NVD_CPEM.json is a curated reference set reconstructed from CPE match entries embedded in the downloaded CVE records. It is not a full independent download of the NVD CPE Match API catalogue.

NVD_CPE.json is a CPE reference index extracted from CVE configurations, not the full NVD CPE API catalogue. CPE catalogue metadata such as official titles, deprecated flags, and CPE UUIDs is not invented.
The source CVE download was based on keyword searches for MySQL and PHP. It may not include every vulnerability relevant to these products.
Validate affected version ranges and CPE product identity against each asset before reporting a vulnerability.
